newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH FIXTURES HIT BY MASS EXODUS OF FOREIGNERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH FIXTURES HIT BY MASS EXODUS OF FOREIGNERS.

text.p: Spanish first division sides will have to find replacements for 42 foreign players who have been called up for international duty this weekend.
Deportivo Coruna, third-placed in the first division, will lose five players for their game against Tenerife, who like leaders Barcelona will be without three foreigners.
Barcelona have already started legal action to end the obligation to cede players and introduce an internationally- coordinated calendar, a move that Deportivo look set to back.
